# Test fixtures

Generated by `make_fixtures.py` (run `uv run python tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py` from the
repo root) and committed, so tests never regenerate them. Regenerating needs the dev
dependencies, the DejaVu Sans font and Pillow built with libraqm.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `text.pdf` | 4-page native text PDF, metadata title, heading per page, repeated header "MC Club Bulletin" and footer "Club MC - Page N / 4" |
| `scanned.pdf` | image-only PDF (fees reminder) → OCR |
| `mixed.pdf` | page 1 native text, page 2 scanned → only page 2 OCR'd |
| `encrypted.pdf` | password-protected (RC4-128, user password "secret") |
| `corrupt.pdf` | first half of `text.pdf` |
| `doc.docx` | H1/H2 headings and a table |
| `sheet.xlsx` | "Schedule" and "Fees" sheets with header rows, plus an empty sheet |
| `notes.md` | Markdown headings |
| `latin1.txt` | French text in Latin-1 (charset fallback) |
| `arabic_cp1256.txt` | Arabic text in Windows-1256 (charset fallback) |
| `notice.png`, `notice.jpg` | English notice image → OCR |
| `arabic_notice.png` | synthetic Arabic notice (DejaVu Sans, shaped with libraqm) → Arabic OCR in logical order |

## Web pages (`web/`)

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `web/mcoli_introduction.html` | Real docs page (Next.js + Fumadocs) saved 2026-10-09 from mcoli-ui.microclub.info, slimmed (no scripts, styles, classes). Permalinked headings, tabbed install commands, link-only list, sidebar/TOC boilerplate |
| `chunking/mcoli_introduction.json` | Golden chunk summary `[heading_path, page_start, token_count]` of `web/mcoli_introduction.html` after preprocessing and chunking with default settings and the real embedder tokenizer. Regenerate with `make_fixtures.py --chunk-golden` (needs tessdata and `tokenizer.json`) only when chunking intentionally changes |

## Real scans (to be added by hand)

Synthetic images are clean. Real-world quality needs real files. Drop non-sensitive scans here,
named exactly as below; the tests that use them are skipped until they exist:

- `arabic_scan.pdf`: a scanned Arabic (or mixed Arabic/French) page
- `arabic_photo.jpg`: a phone photo of an Arabic notice
